Game Overview

In Herotor, the core idea is straightforward: soar through vibrant cityscapes as a dynamic superhero in Herotor. Glide effortlessly above skyscrapers, collect stars, and master the art of quick descents with the thrilling "click-drop" feature. With each level offering fresh challenges, strategic maneuvers and swift reflexes will be your keys to success.
